etymology.historical_story: Khanna occurs in personal names such as Rajesh Khanna, whose name is documented in an Indian government release. Personal names can enter Malay texts through reporting and discussion without becoming Malay common words. The supplied lowercase token lacks enough context to establish that identity, so no surname origin or Malay lexical history is assigned here.
